title: Zettelkasten Note Count Slipbox Mix
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zettel:note
| stats sum(notes_added) as total_output count as records by slipbox
| sort - total_output
description: Shows which slipbox buckets account for most of the activity in zettelkasten note count.
value: A mix view helps you see whether the system is supporting a balanced set of topics or collapsing into one narrow area.
implementation: Map project, tag, graph, or notebook labels consistently so the mix stays meaningful across exports.
visualization: Bar chart of total notes added by slipbox.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which slipbox buckets dominate your zettelkasten note count activity.
